# Subway Seat for Xresources

Foreground, background, cursor, selection and the 16 ANSI colors as wildcard resources, so xterm, urxvt and other X terminals all pick them up. X resources are read once, so there's no light/dark following; pick one flavor.

[Xresources](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/X_resources) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/xresources/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.Xresources`](subway-seat.Xresources) | `~/.config/X11/subway-seat.Xresources` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.Xresources`](subway-seat-tunnel.Xresources) | `~/.config/X11/subway-seat-tunnel.Xresources` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.Xresources`](subway-seat-enamel.Xresources) | `~/.config/X11/subway-seat-enamel.Xresources` |
| London Moquette | [`london-moquette.Xresources`](london-moquette.Xresources) | `~/.config/X11/london-moquette.Xresources` |
| London Deep Level | [`london-deep-level.Xresources`](london-deep-level.Xresources) | `~/.config/X11/london-deep-level.Xresources` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.Xresources, then run `xrdb -merge ~/.Xresources`:

```conf
#include ".config/X11/subway-seat.Xresources"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.Xresources, then run `xrdb -merge ~/.Xresources`:

```conf
#include ".config/X11/subway-seat-tunnel.Xresources"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.Xresources, then run `xrdb -merge ~/.Xresources`:

```conf
#include ".config/X11/subway-seat-enamel.Xresources"
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.Xresources, then run `xrdb -merge ~/.Xresources`:

```conf
#include ".config/X11/london-moquette.Xresources"
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.Xresources, then run `xrdb -merge ~/.Xresources`:

```conf
#include ".config/X11/london-deep-level.Xresources"
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.Xresources, then run `xrdb -merge ~/.Xresources`:

```conf
#include ".config/X11/london-portland.Xresources"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/X11/subway-seat.Xresources`.
- Delete `~/.config/X11/subway-seat-tunnel.Xresources`.
- Delete `~/.config/X11/subway-seat-enamel.Xresources`.
- Delete `~/.config/X11/london-moquette.Xresources`.
- Delete `~/.config/X11/london-deep-level.Xresources`.
- Delete `~/.config/X11/london-portland.Xresources`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
